{{Quote|Please don't kill me! I'm only doing my job!|Vula|<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>}}
'''Vula''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who worked as a receptionist for the [[Bumani Exchange Corporation]], a front for the [[Exchange]], on [[Citadel Station]] over [[Telos IV]].

==Biography==
{{GameLSmechanics|Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords}}
One day, [[Koobis (First Jedi Purge)|Koobis]] paged her and said that [[Meetra Surik]] was coming to see [[Loppak Slusk]]. When she came in, Vula told her she didn't have an appointment. Despite that, Surik got in. On her way out, after her [[Skirmishes on Citadel Station|encounter]] with Slusk and [[Luxa]], she asked Surik not to kill her. Surik told her to leave the Exchange Suites if she wanted to live. She quickly did so.
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
When first meeting Vula the player has several options:
Persuade/Force persuade her, or tell her you don't have an appointment. If the latter is chosen, or you fail the persuade check, four [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorreans]] attack you in the next room.
After your first fight in the Exchange Suites, you can optionally decide to kill Vula, thus gaining dark side points.
